why: Spellings the transcriber got wrong as TEXT while getting right as SOUND. Applied to the burned-in captions and to the exported .srt from one place, so the two can never disagree about what is written on screen. Deliberately tiny and explicit: a broad rewrite pass would be a way to quietly put words on screen that were never spoken, which is the one thing a subtitle may never do.

rules.note: Scribe spells out the letters it heard; the word is I.O.U.s
